# THE_HAPPY_ENDING_FUNDING_PROPOSAL

Status: non-normative external proposal

This document is intentionally separate from REPEAT_CORE_v1 and outside the repository's normative implementation and governance paths. It is a proposal only. It is not a specification, protocol requirement, canonical rule, or schema definition.

## Governing principle

The Happy Ending may fund REPEAT. It does not define REPEAT.

This distinction is deliberate. REPEAT is the verification system, semantics, rules, receipts, and governance artifacts maintained in the repository. The Happy Ending is a possible commercial funding source and a separate intention or plan. The proposal does not amend the core semantics of REPEAT.

## Scope

This document exists to record a potential commercial relationship between The Happy Ending and REPEAT without creating dependency or protocol obligations.

It is not intended to:

- change any REPEAT schema or canonicalization rule
- modify any verifier, receipt, or implementation behavior
- alter governance or normative interpretation in REPEAT_CORE_v1
- establish a requirement that REPEAT accept or depend on funding from The Happy Ending
- create any new protocol dependency or contractual obligation

## Funding status

No revenue relationship is currently verified.

This proposal describes an intention, not evidence of funding. The existence of a proposal does not establish that funds exist, that terms are agreed, that a transaction has occurred, or that REPEAT is commercially dependent on The Happy Ending.

## Relationship to REPEAT

The Happy Ending may fund REPEAT, but the funding relationship is external to REPEAT's technical and governance semantics. REPEAT remains governed by its own repository rules, specification, and normative artifacts.

This proposal therefore creates no dependency or protocol requirement. It is informational only and does not alter the behavior, interpretation, or authority of the core REPEAT system.

## Externality statement

This file is deliberately located in an external documentation path to preserve the clean separation between:

- a commercial idea or funding possibility; and
- the normative REPEAT system.

The proposal is non-binding and non-normative. It may be revisited in a separate product or commercial track, but it does not define or constrain REPEAT itself.
